_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Certification Data Report
summary: The Certification Data Report verifies that qualifications, tests, inspections, or installations have been completed or that documentation is identical, interchangeable, compatible, reliable, or complete.
use_relationship:
The Certification Data Report is required to verify that specific qualifications have been obtained, tests have been performed, parts/assemblies/equipment/systems have been installed, tested, inspected and are ready for operation; that personnel have specific qualifications to perform assignments/operations/inspections; or to certify identicalness, interchangeability, compatibility, reliability, or completeness of documentation being prepared or reviewed by a contractor. The technical effort involved will be the result of equipment, procurement, or contract requirements.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-80678.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be typewritten in narrative format. Contractor's format is acceptable.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the contract number and data item sequence number, and shall contain a statement that specifically identifies the purpose and applicability of this certification.

preparation_instructions.title: Technical Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The technical content shall be in accordance with the appendix entitled "Certification Data/Report Technical Content Requirements," contained in the applicable military specification as stated in the DD Form 1423, Contract Data Requirements List. The technical content shall be as specified on the DD Form 1423, Contract Data Requirements List and the contract requirements.

preparation_instructions.title: Certification of Completion.
preparation_instructions.content: Certification that tests have been performed, inspections made, parts/assemblies/equipments/systems have been installed, tested, inspected, and are ready for operation, or that specific qualifications have been obtained shall provide objective evidence in support of the certification. Objective evidence may include such items as spectrographs, radiographs, material sampling, analysis, inspection and testing reports, or any other necessary documentation.

preparation_instructions.title: Certification of Personnel.
preparation_instructions.content: Certifications that personnel have specific qualifications shall be supported by licenses, permits, tests, statements of competency, or other documentation. The specific capabilities to perform an assignment, inspection, or other operations shall be stated in the certification.

preparation_instructions.title: Certification of Compliance.
preparation_instructions.content: Certification of compliance to specific specification requirements shall be a statement to the effect that the contractor has complied.

preparation_instructions.title: Supplemental Information.
preparation_instructions.content: Additional specific material, drawings, sketches, photographs, etc., in support of these certifications shall be as defined in the DD Form 1423 and the contract requirements.

preparation_instructions.title: Signature.
preparation_instructions.content: The Certification Report shall contain the signature of the contractor's authorized representative. Electronic signatures are acceptable.
